title: Replying to @Readingonplanes Here are the avoidable mistakes I made a...
transcript: here's 3 things I wish I'd done differently before seeing Masquerade the immersive Phantom of the opera show like I said in my review video two of these were more my fault the other one though, not so much I'll start with the one that I really don't think was my fault which is that I found this mask really uncomfortable so as you might already know every audience member is required to wear a mask like this and you are allowed to bring your own but this is the free one that they give out to anyone who doesn't bring their own and it's made of this woven material that I found extremely coarse and rough and irritating I was genuinely struggling for the majority of the show to get it to sit in a way that wasn't poking and scratching at my face I don't know if it's just me but that was my experience so the thing I wish I'd done differently is brought my own mask even if it was just something cheap from the store that I knew was comfortable second thing I wish I'd done differently I wish I'd gone in more caffeinated I saw the show after a long day and I was on the fence about like do I need a little more caffeine to pep me up a little bit? I decided not to because I was like maybe the adrenaline from the experience will fuel me through it but I did not find that to be the case I know that sounds really specific but I think the broader lesson is you know, this is a very expensive experience so, I wish I had done everything in my power to make sure I was in the right state, physically and mentally, going into it the 3rd thing is that I wish I had dressed much more warmly you might be like “oh but Joe. they literally warned you about this “ “in the info email before the show” and yes that's why it's my fault I left my jacket at the coat check and I was wearing like a button down long sleeve dress shirt and I thought that would be enough but it absolutely wasn't next thing I'm gonna say is, I guess a little bit of a spoiler although I've since Learned that this is all over TikTok but anyway if that's a concern for you, keep scrolling but as you might have seen, there is an outdoor section to the show and I was very cold they were handing out shawls to people to wrap around themselves but it was not done in a very systematic way I was like trying to get the eye contact of someone who was handing them out and I couldn't really so I was just very cold during those two scenes but here's the kicker: that wasn't it I was cold inside the building too, to be honest so yeah those are the three avoidable things that I would definitely do differently if I went again
